lanes.evidence: Every provider GET is mapped to an ETL stream and an implemented CLI command; fixture proof covers `outreach prospects list`.

The CLI labels the 163 typed write commands as reverse_etl, but the disposition classifies their provider operations as direct_write and records reverse-ETL eligibility as declaration-pending because there is no action-owned source evidence for per-record acknowledgement and read-back. This evidence does not promote them to a source-validated reverse-ETL lane.
All 96 provider GET operations are ETL streams. The imported provider inventory declares no independent page-wise direct-read operation, so none is fabricated.

POST/PATCH/DELETE operations have exact typed writes.json method/path contracts and implemented command bindings. `delete account apply` represents 36 documented destructive DELETE operations without a safety exclusion.
The pinned OpenAPI document and custom-object supplement enumerate JSON:API operations only; no binary-download operation is captured.
The pinned OpenAPI document and custom-object supplement enumerate JSON:API operations only; no binary-upload operation is captured.
